## Summary
Build the LCME Readiness Room dashboard that shows curriculum coverage metrics, Three-Hub compliance status, assessment quality evidence (reliability + equity), and generates exportable evidence packages for LCME accreditation site visits.

## User story
As a curriculum dean, I want a single dashboard showing LCME readiness metrics (curriculum coverage, assessment reliability, equity compliance, at-risk student counts), so that I can prepare evidence packages for accreditation site visits and identify compliance gaps proactively.

## Why this matters
LCME accreditation is existential for MSM. Without a readiness dashboard, preparing for site visits requires weeks of manual data gathering. Missing coverage gaps or equity issues discovered during a visit could threaten accreditation. This dashboard surfaces all compliance evidence in one place, backed by the Three-Hub Invariant (D06) and verified TEACHES chains (D07).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] LcmeReadinessRoom displays four panels: Coverage, Reliability, Equity, At-Risk
- [ ] Coverage panel: percentage of SubConcepts connected to all three hubs (SubConcept + SLO + USMLE_Subtopic)
- [ ] Coverage panel: only counts TEACHES edges with evidence_grade A or B as verified (D07)
- [ ] Coverage panel: lists uncovered SubConcepts with missing hub connections
- [ ] Coverage computed using bit vector for efficient popcount
- [ ] Reliability panel: aggregates KR-20 across all exams, flags those below 0.70
- [ ] Equity panel: aggregates DIF analysis, counts Category B and C items across exams
- [ ] At-Risk panel: summary counts (systemic/cluster/isolated/on_track) from E09-S04
- [ ] Evidence package export: generates timestamped JSON/PDF with all metrics as point-in-time snapshot
- [ ] SLO -> ILO direction verified as CONTRIBUTES_TO in all coverage queries (Rule 8)
- [ ] Neo4j queries use neo4jQuery wrapper (Rule 1)
- [ ] Page file < 30 lines, delegates to LcmeReadinessRoom organism
- [ ] Admin-only access (RLS enforced)

```
      on_track: number

}
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// Pattern: Three-Hub coverage query via neo4jQuery (Rule 1, D06, D07)
// features/analytics/repositories/LcmeReadinessRepository.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client';

export class LcmeReadinessRepository {
  async getCoverageMetrics(institutionId: string) {
    // Count SubConcepts connected to all three hubs via verified TEACHES chains
    const result = await neo4jQuery<{
      total: number;
      covered: number;
      uncovered: Array<{ id: string; name: string; missingHubs: string[] }>;
    }>(
      `MATCH (sc:SubConcept)
       OPTIONAL MATCH (sc)<-[:TEACHES {evidence_grade: 'A'}|:TEACHES {evidence_grade: 'B'}]-(chunk:ContentChunk)
       OPTIONAL MATCH (sc)-[:MAPS_TO]->(slo:SLO)
       OPTIONAL MATCH (slo)-[:CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(ilo:ILO)
       OPTIONAL MATCH (sc)-[:MAPS_TO]->(ut:USMLE_Subtopic)
       WITH sc,
            COUNT(DISTINCT chunk) > 0 AS has_teaches,
            COUNT(DISTINCT slo) > 0 AS has_slo,
            COUNT(DISTINCT ut) > 0 AS has_usmle
       RETURN
         COUNT(sc) AS total,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN has_teaches AND has_slo AND has_usmle THEN 1 END) AS covered`,
      {},
      institutionId,
    );
    return result;
  }
}

// Pattern: Page file < 30 lines
// app/(admin)/lcme-readiness/page.tsx
import { LcmeReadinessRoom } from '@/features/analytics/components/LcmeReadinessRoom';

export default function LcmeReadinessPage() {
  return <LcmeReadinessRoom />;
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E09/E09-S07.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('GET /api/lcme/readiness returns coverage metrics', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'admin');
  const res = await request.get('/api/lcme/readiness?institution_id=test-inst-id', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.coverage).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.coverage.percentage).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
  expect(data.coverage.percentage).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
  expect(data.reliability).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.equity).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.at_risk).toBeDefined();
});

test('POST /api/lcme/evidence-package generates snapshot', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'admin');
  const res = await request.post('/api/lcme/evidence-package', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    data: { institution_id: 'test-inst-id' },
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.package_id).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.generated_at).toBeDefined();
});

test('Evidence package is immutable point-in-time snapshot', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'admin');
  // Generate two packages
  const res1 = await request.post('/api/lcme/evidence-package', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    data: { institution_id: 'test-inst-id' },
  });
  const { data: pkg1 } = await res1.json();
  // Each package has a unique ID and timestamp
  expect(pkg1.package_id).toBeDefined();
});

test('Negative: faculty cannot generate evidence package', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'faculty');
  const res = await request.post('/api/lcme/evidence-package', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    data: { institution_id: 'test-inst-id' },
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403);
});

test('Negative: student cannot access readiness dashboard', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'student');
  const res = await request.get('/api/lcme/readiness?institution_id=test-inst-id', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403);
});

// tests/E09/E09-S07.ui.test.ts
test('LCME Readiness Room renders four panels', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/lcme-readiness');
  await expect(page.getByText('Coverage')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Reliability')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Equity')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('At-Risk')).toBeVisible();
});
```
